movement_prompts.mochi: Use case: style-transfer. Create a transparent animation sprite sheet for mochi, EXACTLY 8 columns by 5 rows, 40 separate sprites, generous transparent gutters, preferably 2880x1550. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL MOVEMENT reference: copy the limb positions, facing direction and frame order cell-for-cell. Image 2 is the APPROVED APPEARANCE reference: match its round cute proportions, expressive eyes, soft storybook fur, clean dark warm outlines, colors, flower accessory, fitted floral vest and neckband with gold acorn pendant. Apply that appearance to EVERY movement pose. Do not carry over Mochi's cushion. Maintain one consistent body/head scale throughout sheet; original first walk row changes scale halfway, FIX that scale issue while retaining paw poses. Rows: row1 WALK RIGHT 8 phases; row2 RUN RIGHT 8 phases including extended airborne and tucked gathered poses; row3 WALK LEFT 8 phases; row4 RUN LEFT 8 phases; row5 columns1-4 WALK TOWARD CAMERA 4 phases, columns5-8 WALK AWAY FROM CAMERA 4 phases showing back of head/body. Four anatomical legs only, preserve each reference paw's placement and smooth gait changes. Clothes wrap torso naturally, armholes follow shoulders, flower fixed at same anatomical side, pendant hangs from neck and swings slightly with gait. Rear view should show back of vest, NOT a face or chest pendant. Same outfit/colors/pattern in every cell. No human hands, cursor, keyboard, cushion, motion lines, shadows, text, borders, labels, ground or scenery. Fully transparent backdrop. Each sprite fully contained in its own equal grid cell; keep tails and ears clear of gutters. Exact 40 cells essential.
